section_header: REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION - Rear Wheel Alignment
title: REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION - Rear Wheel Alignment

content.description: Top-down view of rear axle showing two wheels and differential assembly with suspension members

items: (a) Measure the distance between each disc wheel and the differential carrier cover bolt of the suspension member and confirm that both are the same.
(b) If the distances are not the same but within 5 mm (0.20 in.), adjust with the toe-in adjusting bolt.

content.description: Side view of toe-in adjustment mechanism showing toe-out and toe-in positions with front and rear orientation markers and center line

items: (c) Move the vehicle forward a few meters with the front wheels in the straight-ahead position on a level place.
(d) Mark on each center of rear tread and measure the distance between marks off the right and left tires.
(e) Advance the vehicle till the marks on the rear sides of the tires come to the measuring heights of the gauge on the front sides.

content.text: NOTE: Toe-in should be measured at the same point on the tire and at the same level.

content.description: Top-down view of two rear wheels showing measurement points for toe-in alignment

content.text: (f) If not within specification, turn the left and right adjusting bolts an equal amount to adjust.
NOTE: The toe-in will change about 1 mm (0.04 in.) with each graduation of the cam (one side).

content.description: Side view of toe-in adjustment mechanism identical to diagram 2, showing toe-out and toe-in positions with front and rear orientation markers and center line

content.text: (g) Tighten the bolts after adjustment the toe-in.
6. INSPECT SIDE SLIP WITH SIDE SLIP TESTER
Side slip limit: Less than 3.0 mm per meter (0.118 in. per 3.3 ft)
If the side slip exceeds this limit, the toe-in or camber may not be correct.

content.description: Side view of a wheel on a side slip tester platform showing measurement setup
